bind_address.description: IP address (IPv4 or IPv6) to bind the NTP server to (e.g., '0.0.0.0' for all interfaces or '127.0.0.1' for localhost only).

ntp_port.description: UDP port on which the NTP service listens. Standard NTP port is 123.

nts_enable.description: Enable or disable Network Time Security (NTS) for encrypted and authenticated time synchronization.

nts_key_file.description: Path to the NTS server private key file (PEM format). Required if NTS is enabled.

nts_cert_file.description: Path to the NTS server X.509 certificate file (PEM format). Required if NTS is enabled.

allowed_subnets.description: List of client subnets (CIDR) allowed to query this NTP server. Empty list denies all clients.

refclock_enabled.description: Enable a hardware reference clock (e.g., GPS receiver with PPS). Only needed if server is a stratum-0/1 time source.

refclock_path.description: Device path to the refclock source (e.g., /dev/pps0, /dev/gps0).

peers.description: List of upstream NTP servers to synchronize with. Optional NTS support per peer.

address.description: Hostname or IP of upstream NTP server.

nts.description: If true, attempt NTS negotiation with this peer. Requires NTS enabled globally.

state_dir.description: Directory to store persistent state (drift, leap seconds, peer stats). Must be writable by the ntpd-rs user.

max_rate.description: Maximum request rate per source IP (packets/second). Set to 0 to disable rate limiting.

init_sync_mode.description: Behavior during initial startup synchronization. 'fast' aggressively syncs; 'normal' uses standard slewing; 'disabled' skips initial sync.
